title: alloplectus nummularia
intro: Alloplectus nummularia, commonly known as  Nummularia or Lycopodiopsida, is a type of ancient plant that belongs to the family Lycopodiaceae, characterized by its small, scale-like leaves and woody stems. The health benefits of Alloplectus nummularia include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health. It is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Alloplectus nummularia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
